subject: Boycott Burnout 3!
author: ZombieTron
body:
If Burnout 3 is ever made available on the marketplace as an Xbox Original I will definatly promote a boycott unless it is going to have online support.

I already posted in the Xbox Originals forum for no-one to buy Burnout 3 as the servers had been switched off, but that was before it was pulled from the Originals launch.

It seems that Burnout 3 is unavailable online again, but it was really fun having what might turn out to be a last hoorah on Tuesday night!

--- The Original and the Best ---
